g.text: 15. standard-front (front-rank): the pairwise engine, rung 0, "base", seed 1, 46 s to 48.25 s
the standard is carried by a man with no slot ahead of him. Men: 96. Body: hastati, second century.
+ a slot, joined to its man when he is away from it · □ the standard · ○ the men the flag is about · red line: a bout
